title: Remove and stow a YAM linear gripper
instruction: Loosen both captive screws on the de-energized YAM wrist with the blue driver. Slide the old gripper off the wrist, lay it in the empty cradle, and release it.
setup: A donor wrist with its installed Linear 4310 gripper, a blue driver in a clutch-shoulder dock, and an empty gripper cradle.
scoring: Half credit after both heads turn at least 670 degrees while the physical bit is engaged and rise at least 0.85 mm. Full credit after the removed gripper is stationary in its cradle with the tool and gripper released and both screws still loose for one second.
fidelity: Uses the same YAM CAD, captive M3 bench adapter, physical hex engagement, and simulated thread advance as the replacement task.
context: Remove a worn gripper from a de-energized wrist fixture for service.
reset_notes: Restore the mounted module, both captive screws, the docked driver and the empty cradle.
